'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**An [[Israel Defence Forces|IDF]] [[91st Division (Israel)|129th Battalion]] soldier is killed and two other soldiers were injured by a Hezbollah drone strike near [[Margaliot]], which also caused a fire in a building. Another drone was shot down by the IDF, which then shelled and launched airstrikes on Hezbollah targets. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-778304 (JPost)]
*[[Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Three Brotherhood Alliance]] claims to have captured [[Namhsan]] in the northern [[Shan State]], following a joint [[Offensive (military)|offensive]] against the [[Tatmadaw|Myanmar military]] despite a temporary [[ceasefire]] mediated by [[China]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20231216-myanmar-s-three-brotherhood-alliance-seizes-town-from-military-despite-china-backed-ceasefire (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russia]] says that two [[civilian]]s are killed and two others are injured in a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[missile]] strike on the Russian-occupied village of [[Nova Maiachka]] in [[Kherson Raion]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/12/16/Moscow-s-forces-say-Ukrainian-missile-kills-two-in-Russian-held-village (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)|Yemeni Crisis]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Royal Navy]]'s [[HMS Diamond (D34)|HMS ''Diamond'']] shoots down a [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] launched from [[Houthi movement|Houthi]]-controlled territory in [[Yemen]] over the [[Red Sea]] using a [[PAAMS|Sea Viper missile]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/16/shipping-companies-suspend-red-sea-traffic-after-yemen-rebel-attacks (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Libya migrant boats sinking]]
**A boat departing from [[Zuwarah]], [[Libya]], carrying about 86 [[illegal immigrant]]s from various [[African countries]], [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|sinks]] in the [[Mediterranean Sea]], killing about 61 of them. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/12/17/migrant-tragedy-libya-north-africa/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*At least 13 people are killed after a [[thunderstorm]] strikes [[Bahía Blanca]], [[Argentina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/severe-storm-strikes-coastal-city-argentina-least-13-dead-2023-12-17/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and two others injured when a wall of the Gate of Floggers collapses while it is being renovated in [[Kairouan]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/16/three-killed-while-repairing-ancient-wall-at-kairouan-unesco-world-heritage-site-in-tunisia (''The Guardian'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[China Meteorological Administration]] issues a [[Weather warning|low-temperature warning]], [[weather forecasting|forecasting]] a [[cold wave]] affecting most of the [[China|country]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/freezing-temperatures-in-northern-china-trigger-alert (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Government of Iran|Iran]] [[executes]] an alleged [[Mossad]] agent in [[Sistan and Baluchistan province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-executes-agent-israels-mossad-intelligence-service-official-media-2023-12-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gansu ultramarathon disaster]]
**A [[Judicial system of China|court]] in [[Baiyin]], [[Gansu]], [[China]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] five organizers of a 2021 [[ultramarathon]] to prison terms ranging from three to five and a half years, following the deaths of 21 runners due to [[Cold front|extreme weather]] during the event. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/organisers-of-deadly-2021-china-ultramarathon-sentenced-to-jail (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*Fifteen suspected [[Illegal drug trade|drug smugglers]] are killed and about 2 million [[methamphetamine]] tablets are seized during a [[shootout]] with [[Royal Thai Army|soldiers]] at [[Thailand]]'s [[Myanmar–Thailand border|border]] with [[Myanmar]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-methamphetamine-bust-15-drug-smugglers-killed-cf425caad7f39378f767ac8911a5c539 (AP)]
*A court in the [[Holy See]] sentences [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)|Cardinal]] [[Giovanni Angelo Becciu]] to five and a half years in prison for [[embezzlement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/cardinal-nine-other-defendants-await-verdicts-vatican-trial-2023-12-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Emir of Kuwait]] [[Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah]] dies at 86. His half-brother, [[Crown Prince of Kuwait|Crown Prince]] [[Mishal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah]], succeeds him as the new [[emir]]. [https://www.tbsnews.net/worldbiz/middle-east/kuwait-crown-prince-sheikh-meshal-named-new-emir-758538 (AFP via ''TBS'')]
